title: UCC response (MCX)
purpose: MCX's answer to a UCC upload batch: a control record and one line per client code with MCX's error code, blank when the record was taken.

columns.name: Batch Number
columns.note: the batch of the member's file (01 to 99)

columns.name: Error Code
columns.note: three digits from MCX's list of UCC error codes (section 1.3); blank when the record was taken

linked: Marks each client of the batch accepted or rejected at MCX, with the error in words; rejected clients become work items
source: MCX circular MCX/TECH/023/2022 (13 Jan 2022), MCX UCC File Formats (Version 1.0), sections 1.2 and 1.3
